# Super Pest Control Services

> Super Pest Control Services provides residential and commercial pest management across Rajasthan, including termite, cockroach, rodent, mosquito, bed bug, fumigation, and general pest control treatments.

Super Pest Control Services serves homes, businesses, hospitality venues, food and beverage facilities, warehouses, retail locations, offices, and institutions. The company is based in Jaipur and also has an office in Beawar.

## Main Pages

- [Super Pest Control Services homepage](https://superpest.in/): Company overview and access to all site sections.
- [Pest control services](https://superpest.in/services/): Overview of residential, commercial, and specialized pest control services.
- [Residential pest control](https://superpest.in/residential-pest-control/): Pest management services for homes and residential properties.
- [Commercial pest control](https://superpest.in/commercial-pest-control/): Pest management programs for businesses and commercial facilities.
- [Service locations](https://superpest.in/service-location/): Rajasthan cities and areas covered by the company.

## Company Information

- [About Super Pest Control Services](https://superpest.in/about/): Company background, approach, and credentials.
- [Pest control blog](https://superpest.in/blog/): Pest prevention and treatment information.
- [Contact and booking](https://superpest.in/contact/): Phone numbers, email address, offices, and service enquiries.

**Services:** The company provides termite and wood borer control, general pest control, rodent management, vector control and fogging, bed bug treatment, commercial fumigation, fly management systems, sanitization and disinfection, commercial AMC/IPM programs, and customized pest management.

**Coverage:** Service coverage includes Ajmer, Alwar, Balotra, Banswara, Baran, Barmer, Beawar, Bharatpur, Bhilwara, Bikaner, Bundi, Chittorgarh, Churu, Dausa, Deeg, Dholpur, Didwana-Kuchaman, Dungarpur, Hanumangarh, Jaipur, Jaisalmer, Jalore, Jhalawar, Jhunjhunu, Jodhpur, Karauli, Khairthal-Tijara, Kota, Kotputli-Behror, Nagaur, Pali, Phalodi, Pratapgarh, Rajsamand, Salumbar, Sawai Madhopur, Sikar, Sirohi, Sri Ganganagar, Tonk, and Udaipur.

Contact details: Phone +91 98280 66990 and +91 79765 72984; email superpestcontrolservices.jaipur@gmail.com; Jaipur office at 82/270, Sector-8, Pratap Nagar, Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302033; Beawar office at 29, Fatehpuriya, Gomati Nagar, Beawar, Rajasthan 305901.
